name: dew-rabbit
artworkMethod: Full-strip newly drawn cels with image_gen eye-open correction, composited only inside the declared eye masks.
method: Eight-pose full-strip drawn animation from the locked approved seed using built-in image_gen. Six new intermediate drawings; exact approved seed at both endpoints. No mesh deformation, crossfades or synthetic inbetweens.
trajectory: Rear-foot loading, raised front paws, fast forward double-paw shove, short contact hold and paw/ear recoil. Pose 4 has a deliberate 12px takeoff lift; support feet share the approved seed baseline.

eyeCorrection.generatedRegistration: One common canvas rescale from generated 1774x887 to original2048x1024; integer local eye-patch offsets only. Original drawn frame registration, scale, silhouette and duration remain unchanged.
eyeCorrection.maskMethod: Rounded rectangles with10px corners and2px Gaussian edge feather; only corrected eye/eyelid area is composited.
